title: Price tolerance
text: Invoices with unit price variance within 2 percent of the purchase order price are released for payment.

title: Price above tolerance
text: Price variance above tolerance is held and the supplier is asked for a credit note to the PO price.

title: Goods receipt match
text: Payment is released only for the quantity recorded on the goods receipt note.

title: Partial delivery
text: For partial delivery the received quantity is paid and a debit note is raised for the balance invoiced.

title: No PO no pay
text: Invoices without a purchase order are not paid unless the budget owner approves a retrospective PO.

title: Retrospective approval
text: Retrospective PO approval is a judgment call by the budget owner and is always reviewed by a person.

title: Duplicate check
text: Invoices matching supplier, amount and date of an already paid invoice are rejected as duplicates.

title: Resubmitted invoices
text: Resubmitted copies of an invoice are released only when the duplicate check confirms a distinct invoice.

title: Tax code master
text: The tax rate and HSN or tax code on the invoice must match the vendor and item master.

title: Corrected tax invoice
text: Invoices with a GST or VAT mismatch are held until the supplier issues a corrected tax invoice.
